page_title: Rajendra P N - Lead DevSecOps & Release Engineer
headline: Lead DevSecOps & Release Engineer | Azure Cloud, Azure DevOps, Azure Bicep, CI/CD & Kubernetes
summary_html: Lead DevSecOps & Release Engineer with 10+ years of hands-on experience driving Azure Cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipeline engineering, release management, DevSecOps security automation, and production operational support. Proactive, self-directed engineer experienced partnering closely with enterprise architects while independently taking ownership of assigned technical deliverables with minimal direction across US-daytime operations. Deep expertise across Microsoft Azure, Azure DevOps, Azure Bicep, Terraform, Docker, and Kubernetes, alongside Jenkins (Groovy), GitLab CI, and GitHub Actions to build, maintain, and improve automated delivery workflows. Embeds DevSecOps controls—threat modeling, SAST/DAST, vulnerability management, and policy gates—across release planning, change control, and production quality processes. Proven track record handling production incidents, incident response, and root-cause troubleshooting while integrating Prometheus, Grafana, and OpenTelemetry observability to proactively improve delivery velocity and operational reliability.

achievements.text: Defined and championed enterprise DevSecOps frameworks across Azure Cloud and multi-cloud environments, embedding threat modeling, automated SAST/DAST scanning, secret detection, artifact signing, and policy-driven merge gates.
Built, maintained, and improved CI/CD pipelines across Azure DevOps, Jenkins, and GitLab CI alongside modular Azure Bicep and Terraform IaC for repeatable Docker and Kubernetes releases.

Supported release planning, release quality, and end-to-end delivery across dev, test, UAT, and production—enforcing semantic versioning, ServiceNow/CAB change control, ITIL approvals, go/no-go readiness, and automated rollbacks.

Provided US-daytime production operational support and incident response, partnering closely with enterprise architects while independently driving troubleshooting, reliability improvements, and Prometheus/Grafana/OpenTelemetry observability.
